data.text:
Sheema Haiden vs State Of Kerala on 11 April, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr. Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas
 Thursday, the 11th day of April 2024 / 22nd Chaithra, 1946 
 Crl.Mc No. 3116 Of 2024
 Crime No.0/0 Of ,
 St 3536/2022 Of Judl. Magi. Of First Class-Iii, Kottayam
Petitioner(S)/Accused No.7:
 Sheema Haiden, Aged 41 Years, W/O Haiden, Kanichai House,
 Kudakuthukunnu, Mala, Thrissur District, Pin-680732
Respondent(S)/State & Complainant:
 1. State Of Kerala, Represented By Public Prosecutor, High Court Of
 Kerala, Ernakulam, Pin- 682031
 2. The Food Safety Officer, Kottayam Circle, Office Of The Food Safety
 Officer Kottayam Circle 1St Floor, Block Panchayath Office Building,
 Vadavathoor P.O. Kottayam, Pin-686010
 This Criminal Misc. case coming on for orders, upon persuing the
petition and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.Sruthy K.K, P.M.Rafiq,
M.Revikrishnan, Ajeesh K.Sasi, Sruthy N. Bhat, Rahul Sunil, Nikita J.
Mendez, Nanditha S. & Sohail Ahammed Harris P.P., Advocates for the
petitioner and of Addl.Director General Of Prosecution, Addl. State Public
Prosecutor & Public Prosecutor for R1 , the court passed the following:
 BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, J  -------------------------------------------
 Crl.M.C.No.3116 of 2024  -------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 11th day of April, 2024  ORDER The ADGP, who appears for the respondents, raised a preliminary objection regarding the correctness of Annexure-3. It is pointed out that, in the body of the memorandum of Crl.M.C, it is stated that, Annexure-3 is a revised list of food additives issued in the year 2023 and according to him, there is no such list issued in the said year. 
2. In view of the above, the petitioner shall produce the proper document relating to Annexure-3 for perusal of the Court. 
Sheema Haiden vs State Of Kerala on 11 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179098087/
1 In the meantime, the appearance of the petitioner before the trial court in S.T.No.3536/2022 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kottayam shall be deferred till the next posting date. 
Post on 30.05.2024. 
Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE Sbna/
Sheema Haiden vs State Of Kerala on 11 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179098087/
